Your presets. Their original format.

Open, preview and save a separate copy in the original format.

1 · Open an original file

Content is validated, not trusted by extension. Original filenames are retained on download; SynthOne upstream single exports use .synth1 and bank imports use .json.

2 · Inspect and optionally rename

Choose a file to preview.

3 · Save a separate copy

All sequence, arp, FX, tuning, UID, wrapper and unknown fields remain intact. Only existing name text is editable here.
